ExtraBar 1.4.1 – Vertical Bars, Tinted Icons & a Bookmark Safety Net! 📐🎨🗑️

Break free from the top of the screen with vertical bars, give your items a clean monochrome look, and delete bookmarks without fear thanks to a brand-new Recycle Bin.

✨ New Features

  • Vertical Bar Positions: The floating bar is no longer stuck to the top — dock it to the left or right edge as a vertical bar, with five placements in all: Top, Left, Right, Top Left, and Top Right! A new visual screen-edge picker in Settings → Display Modes lets you choose by clicking directly on a mockup of your screen!
  • Tint Your Icons: Match the clean, monochrome look of native macOS menu bar items by tinting any bar item's icon into a single-color silhouette — right-click an item (or use its ⋯ menu) and choose Tint Icon to pick White, Black, or an accent color! Tinting is offered for icons with a real shape (custom icons, SF Symbols, folders, and widgets), full-color app icons are left untouched, and your choice travels with presets on export/import!
  • Recycle Bin for Bookmarks (Shiori): Deleting a bookmark now moves it to a Recycle Bin instead of removing it permanently — restore it, Delete Forever, or Empty Trash right from the Bookmark Manager, and search within the bin! Deletions sync quietly across your devices, and a restore always wins over a stale deletion!

🔧 Improvements

  • Right-Click the Collapse Icon: In both floating-bar and menu-bar modes, right-clicking (or ⌃-clicking) the collapse/menu-mode icon now opens the standard app menu — Open ExtraBar, mode toggles, Presets, Bookmark Manager, Settings, and Quit!
  • Delete the Default Preset: The default preset can now be deleted, as long as it isn't the active preset and isn't your last one — another preset is instantly promoted to default so you always have one!
  • Clearer Bookmark Import Feedback: The Import sheet now scrolls automatically to show the result, and an import that adds zero bookmarks shows an orange "No Bookmarks Imported" (empty file or all duplicates) instead of a misleading green "success"!
  • Honest Delete Warnings: Bookmark delete confirmations now say the bookmark moves to the Recycle Bin and can be recovered, rather than "this action cannot be undone" — folder-only and mixed deletions still spell out exactly what's permanent!

What's Next?

We're always working on making ExtraBar more powerful and intuitive! More features and improvements are on the way based on your feedback!

Thank you for being part of the ExtraBar community! Your feedback drives every improvement we make.
